strings.sat.desc.iss: ʻO ke ana noho nui loa ma ka lewa. Noho mau kekahi hui mea lele lewa ma luna ona, a puni ʻo ia i ka Honua i kēlā me kēia 92 minuke paha. ʻO ia ka mea ʻālohilohi loa e holo ana i ka lani pō.
strings.sat.desc.css: Keʻena lewa o Kina, i noho ʻia mai ka 2021. ʻOi aku ka liʻiliʻi i ke Keʻena Lewa Honua, akā i ka holo maikaʻi, kokoke like ka ʻālohilohi.
strings.sat.desc.hst: He ʻike hōkū lewa i hoʻokuʻu ʻia i ka 1990 nāna i hoʻololi i ko kākou ʻike no ke ao holoʻokoʻa. Ua paʻi kiʻi ʻo ia i nā hōkū lewa mamao loa a kōkua i ka ana ʻana i ka wikiwiki o ka hoʻonui ʻana o ke ao holoʻokoʻa.
strings.sat.desc.acs3: He satelaika hoʻāʻo o NASA me kahi peʻa lā ma kahi o 80 m², i hoʻoneʻe ʻia wale nō e ke kaomi o ka mālamalama lā. Hoʻolilo ke peʻa ʻālohilohi iā ia i mea ʻālohilohi no kona nui.
strings.sat.desc.envisat: He satelaika nānā Honua ʻEulopa i ke nui o kahi kaʻa pahu. Nalowale ka pili ʻana me ia i ka 2012, a mai ia manawa mai, ua noho mau ʻo ia ma ka pōʻai ma ke ʻano kekahi o nā ʻāpana ʻōpala lewa nui loa.
strings.sat.desc.amos: Ka ʻano satelaika kamaʻilio o ʻIseraʻela. Aia lākou ma ke kiʻekiʻe ma kahi o 36,000 kilomika, no laila ʻike ʻia lākou e like me ka paʻa ma kahi hoʻokahi o ka lani. ʻAʻole hiki ke ʻike ʻia lākou me ka maka wale, akā kuhikuhi ka polokalamu i ko lākou alo.
strings.sat.desc.eros: He satelaika paʻi kiʻi kiʻekiʻe loa o ʻIseraʻela i hoʻokele ʻia e ImageSat, i hoʻokuʻu ʻia i ka 2022.
strings.sat.desc.venus: He satelaika noiʻi ʻIseraʻela-Palani i hoʻokuʻu ʻia i ka 2017 nāna i paʻi kiʻi i nā mea kanu a me nā ʻāina mahiʻai e hahai ai i nā loli kaiaola.
strings.sat.desc.cat.weather: He satelaika anilā e holo ana ma luna o nā pou. Paʻi kiʻi ʻo ia i nā ao, ʻino, a me nā mahana, a hoʻohana ʻia kāna ʻikepili i nā wānana anilā.
strings.sat.desc.cat.observation: He satelaika e paʻi kiʻi ana i ka ʻili o ka Honua — nā nāhele, nā kūlanakauhale, nā kai, a me ka hau — e hahai ai i ko lākou loli ʻana me ka manawa.
strings.sat.desc.cat.science: He satelaika i kūkulu ʻia e aʻo ai i ka lewa a i ka Honua. ʻAʻole kekahi o lākou e hoʻohana hou ʻia, akā noho mau lākou ma ka pōʻai.
strings.sat.desc.cat.telescope: He ʻike hōkū lewa e nānā ana i ke ao holoʻokoʻa mai luna o ka lewa ea, nāna e omo ana i ka hapa nui o ka mālamalama e hiki mai ana mai ka lewa.
strings.sat.desc.cat.communication: He satelaika e hoʻoili ana i ke kīwī, ka pūnaewele, a me nā kelepona. Lele ka hapa nui o lākou i kiʻekiʻe loa, no laila ʻike ʻia wale nō kekahi mau mea me ka maka wale.
strings.sat.desc.cat.starlink: Hoʻokahi o nā tausani satelaika Starlink o SpaceX, e hāʻawi ana i ka pūnaewele mai ka lewa. Lele lākou ma lalo, no laila maʻalahi ke ʻike ʻia lākou, a i kekahi manawa holo lākou ma kahi laina lōʻihi, hoʻokahi ma hope o kekahi.
strings.sat.desc.cat.rocket: Ka ʻaoʻao luna o kahi rokona, nāna i lawe i ka satelaika i kona pōʻai a noho ʻo ia iho ma laila. He nui kēia mau mea a ʻālohilohi pinepine, no laila maʻalahi ke ʻike ʻia lākou.
strings.identify.proMore: Hoʻomaopopo pū ka Pro i kēlā me kēia hōkū, hui hōkū, a me ka mea lewa hohonu.
